Outfit - Winter Coat and Scarf.description:
👕 Outfit: Winter Coat and Scarf
A long wool coat with a thick knit scarf, gloves and boots.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Outfit - Winter Coat and Scarf.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: A knee-length wool coat buttoned against the cold with the collar turned up, a thick knit scarf in a double loop around the neck, knit gloves, dark trousers or a skirt with dark tights, and ankle boots. Default colors: a camel coat with a deep red scarf. Cut openings for any established wings, tail or extra arms.

Portrait only: inventory and equipped items stay as they are. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; the garment adds no Quirk effect, gear function, rank, license or affiliation. Respect the selected crop.
